subject: POC access sprint — API key delivery, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering runbook
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@medtech.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: POC access sprint — API key delivery, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering runbook

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great alignment on the evaluation objectives. Per our mutual action plan, attaching a compact runbook to get your POC environment live within the next two weeks. The high-level asks we need from MedTech to unblock the sprint are below: 

- Admin contact for org creation (name + email). We will create a Redwood org and invite your SRE and product leads.
- IP ranges for API allowlist (CIDR format) and a preferred egress IP pool we can reserve.
- VPC peering point (account/project id) and approximate maintenance window for peering setup.
- Point of contact for API key handoff and HSM/KMS notes (if you require dedicated key wrapping).

Deliverables attached: MAP_POCAccess_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan + timeline), redwood-vpc-peering-template.docx (peering checklist), network-allowlist.csv (sample CSV to paste into firewall).

Proposed timing:
- Org invite and admin confirmation: within 48 hours of this email
- IP allowlist + service account details: within 72 hours after org invite accepted
- Peering request submitted by ACME/MedTech + peering window confirmed: day 4-6
- API key issued to your org (scoped to POC model): day 6-8

Next steps: Can you confirm the admin contact and a preferred peering window by EOD Wednesday? If any of this conflicts with your change window, we can push the peering to next week but that will shift the close timeline.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the invites and create a one-click checklist in Drive once we hear back.

—
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.ai
(Attachment: MAP_POCAccess_v1.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-vpc-peering-template.docx (docx), network-allowlist.csv (csv))

From: Samira Khan <samira@medtech.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Reed <alex.reed@acmehealth.com>, ACME DevOps <devops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 12:15:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC access sprint — API key delivery, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering runbook

Thanks Priyom — this is very helpful. Quick answers below:

- Admin contact: Alex Reed (alex.reed@acmehealth.com) — he owns infra for the POC.
- IP ranges for allowlist: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/28 (sending full list in a secure sheet).
- Peering: we can schedule peering Tuesday 7/14 between 01:00-03:00 UTC. Our NetOps will open a ticket when you confirm the redwood peering template.
- KMS: we will use our AWS KMS key (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12).

A couple of asks from our side:
1) Will the API key you issue be scoped to only the POC models and not production models?
2) Can you share a minimal test prompt we can use to smoke-test latency from our VPC after peering?

If those two items are confirmed we’ll submit the peering ticket and accept the org invite.

Samira
Head of Product, MedTech Solutions
(Attachment: none)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@medtech.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:10:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: POC access sprint — API key delivery, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering runbook

Looping in short plan from infra side. Priyom — answering Samira’s asks: 

- API key scope: yes, keys issued for POC will be bound to the customer org and a specific model bundle in our catalog; they won’t have access to any internal production-only models. We will add an expiration (30 days) and can rotate per request.
- Smoke test prompt (suggested):
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>' 
    -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-1-small","input":"Summarize: The patient presented with elevated heart rate and chest pain; list 3 potential next steps for triage."}'

- Peering template: Priyom, please confirm the VPC cidr we will advertise and the required route table changes; our template expects the customer to accept a peering request and add two routes.

I will provision a scoped POC key once Alex accepts the org invite and we receive the allowlist CSV. Monica — can you draft the invite copy and include SSO hints in the email? Grace — can you prepare the peering request from our side?

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr Engineering Manager, Infra
(Attachment: redwood-peering-sample.json)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@medtech.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Alex Reed <alex.reed@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access sprint — API key delivery, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering runbook

Samira / Alex — thanks for the quick confirmations and the peering window. Short status update and immediate asks so we can keep the close timeline intact: 

- Org invites sent to Alex Reed and your SRE alias (devops@acmehealth.com) — please accept and confirm admin privileges.
- We received the allowlist CSV and KMS arn — infra has what they need to create the scoped POC key.
- Peering: Grace has the peering request prepared; we will send it to your NetOps at 00:30 UTC on 14 July to align with your 01:00-03:00 UTC window. Please confirm the ticket number once ACME opens it so we can monitor.

Final ask before we issue keys (targeting 14 July, PST): please reply with the peering ticket number and confirm Alex has accepted the org invite. Once both are done, we’ll:
1) Issue scoped POC API key (30-day expiry, model-scoped).
2) Share a minimal Postman collection and the smoke test curl above.
3) Hand off a short runbook to your SREs for rotating keys and verifying KV cache behavior.

If anything slips we’ll surface impact to the projected close date (we estimate GA decision by 2026-07-30 assuming no blockers).

—
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.ai
(Attachment: runbook-summary.txt)
